source.title: Human-reviewed knowledge drafting
source.summary: A reliable knowledge pipeline separates automated extraction and drafting from explicit human approval.
source.why_save: It defines a practical boundary between useful automation and stable knowledge.
useful_ideas: Each Card should contain one reusable idea.
Semantic similarity should inform review without forcing a merge.

cards.title: Automation proposes and humans approve stable knowledge
cards.summary: Automated extraction can prepare drafts, but promotion requires human verification against evidence.
cards.core_idea: Separate machine drafting from human commitment to protect the stable knowledge layer.
cards.when_useful: Use when designing ingestion or note-promotion workflows.
how_to_apply: Keep generated outputs in a draft area.
cards.evidence_excerpt: a human reviewer must verify the claims against the original evidence before promotion

cards.title: One knowledge Card should express one reusable idea
cards.summary: Atomic Cards are easier to retrieve, verify, and update than Cards containing unrelated claims.
cards.core_idea: Card boundaries should follow one reusable claim or procedure.
cards.when_useful: Use while splitting a source into reusable knowledge.
how_to_apply: Move unrelated claims into separate Card candidates.
cards.evidence_excerpt: Each knowledge card should express one reusable idea.
